title: Which tools for low poly assets
author: Shaitan1805
selftext:
Hey there,

Next week I have some time to start a little hobby project with unity. I can code myself, but I have no experience in 3d modelling.

I want to create a little mobile game with unity that should have a 3d low poly style like in the screenshot (screenshot of an existing mobile game which is not mine).

I want to generate the models and some basic animations like running and attacking with AI.

Do you guys can recommend some tool to achieve this?

replies.author: all_seeing_eyes0-0
replies.body: I do not believe blender is a good option to be used AI, was there a new update for that or what? Last time i checked an mcp was needed and it was horrid

replies.author: Doraz_
replies.body:
blender without AI was fine and will always be fine

AI however, expecially when the bubble will pop, investors will back out and you will be billed THE ACTUAL cost of them running ...

I'd say " God help us", but you had the brilliant idea to kill him too 🤷

replies.author: CycleMother2006
replies.body: MCP is not needed, but it helps. But regardless any kind of low poly modeling it's going to struggle with. The results are worse than what even a brand new modeler could come up with, and take the agent 10x the time, too. At least for now, anyone looking to use low poly assets is better off just watching a few tutorials and jumping into the software to begin making whatever they need. It's not exactly a demanding style to create in.

replies.author: all_seeing_eyes0-0
replies.body: Yea thats true, but OP was asking for tools that are good with AI specifically and someone said blender 🤷‍♂️

comments.author: VR38DET
comments.body: Use chatgpt to create a design then plug the image into meshy

comments.author: Easy-Win-4351
comments.body: Blender. And no AI for an artistic cause please.

replies.body: You know which sub this is?
